title: Only the default scope tag exists

minRoleAssignments.text: Role assignments below which one team administers everything and scope tags buy nothing

messages.businessImpact: Every administrator sees every object. In an organisation with more than one support team that means changes intended for one group can reach all of them.
messages.technicalDetail: {Facts.ScopeTags.Count()} scope tags were read from this tenant, and none of them is a tag someone created. Scope tags are under Tenant administration, Roles, Scope (Tags).
remediation: Create scope tags for the boundaries that matter, by region, business unit or support tier.
Apply them to objects and to role assignments together, since a tag on one without the other has no effect.
messages.cannotSee: A run that read no scope tag at all is left alone rather than reported as having only the default, because every tenant has the default and an empty read is a reading failure rather than a finding.
